The published structure for every study option resolves to major courses, elective courses and named coursework subjects across three years; the elective statement confirms electives are unconstrained ordinary courses. G1.rationale: PASS condition — a coherent specialist core with progressive technical or methodological depth via a staged chain. A common commerce core recurs in every study option (business reporting, microeconomics, macroeconomics, quantitative research methods, business communication), and each major documents an explicit staged progression: BUSN1002 states it extends BUSN1001, FINM1001 states it provides the foundation for later finance studies and is followed by FINM2001 Corporate Finance, and COMP1100 states it is the first of three core computing courses and the foundation for more advanced ones. That is disciplinary identity with documented depth, not generic interchangeable content, so the FAIL condition is not met — notwithstanding the heavy elective load and the absence of formal program prerequisites, both recorded as an ambiguity.
